fixtureRequirements.requirement: Use only NOVALURE_QA_PREVIEW_EMAIL and NOVALURE_QA_PREVIEW_PASSWORD with the generic codextest_ email prefix, and bind the exact fixture through NOVALURE_QA_PREVIEW_WORKSPACE_ID, NOVALURE_QA_PREVIEW_FIXTURE_MARKER_KEY=qaFixture, NOVALURE_QA_PREVIEW_FIXTURE_MARKER=go-live-two-tenant-v1, NOVALURE_QA_PREVIEW_ROLE and NOVALURE_QA_PREVIEW_PRODUCT_ROLE. MFA verification additionally requires the matching action-time NOVALURE_QA_PREVIEW_TOTP_SECRET. Values must never be logged or written to evidence.

Provide disposable public Form, public live Funnel and password-reset result URLs only through the documented environment variables or --fixture-input-stdin at action time. Every URL must match the exact Preview origin; URLs and publish/share tokens must never be written to evidence.

The runner must validate Forms, Funnel, Settings, invitation, MFA/login, password-reset and public submit routes against docs/audit/2026-08-23/release-surface-manifest.json before browser work begins.

criteria: WCAG 2.0 A and AA machine-testable rules
WCAG 2.1 A and AA machine-testable rules
automatedChecks.requirement: No Critical or Serious Axe violation and no unresolved Critical or Serious incomplete result on every required public and authenticated matrix entry.
The document language, title, main landmark and authenticated application shell match the expected surface and language.
The first keyboard Tab action reaches a focusable control on every required matrix entry.
Required 200 percent and 400 percent reflow profiles have no horizontal document overflow.
No uncaught page error or browser console error occurs during a required matrix entry.

Every required MFA, invitation, password-reset result, authenticated Forms/Funnel/Settings and public form/funnel page entry must be observed by the read-only automated runner. The real public submit success and validation states are covered by the separately bound public-runtime E2E and the required signed manual public-form-and-funnel-submit-flow evidence; they must never be synthesized by a read-only browser run. A missing or invalid action-time fixture is recorded as redacted BLOCKED and fails the release gate.

manualChecks.requirement: NVDA with Firefox and VoiceOver with Safari can navigate landmarks, headings, controls, status messages and validation errors in both languages on representative public and authenticated views.
Every launch-enabled dialog receives initial focus, retains focus while open, closes by keyboard where intended and returns focus to its invoking control with an unobscured focus indicator.

Login, MFA, password-reset results, invitation, authenticated Forms/Funnel/Settings, and public form/funnel submissions expose persistent labels, instructions, error identification, actionable correction guidance and accessible status announcements without relying on color alone.

All launch-enabled actions in dashboard, contacts, pipelines, tasks, meetings, forms, funnels, settings and invitation management are operable with keyboard only, in a logical focus order, without a trap and with visible unobscured focus.

Representative public and authenticated flows remain usable at 200 percent zoom, 400 percent reflow and WCAG text-spacing overrides, with no lost content, controls or essential two-dimensional context.
Representative mobile flows work in portrait and landscape without orientation lock, and pointer targets meet the WCAG 2.2 minimum or a documented exception.

In DE and EN, the isolated Preview fixture completes MFA without losing focus context, password-reset success and failure results are announced, and the invitation surface exposes its launch state, validation and result without an inaccessible dead end.

Approved disposable public Form and Funnel fixtures can be completed and submitted in DE and EN on desktop, mobile and the selected 400-percent reflow profile; validation and success states are perceivable, keyboard operable and announced.
